items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: St. Augustine High School was built and opened by Father Oruk and my father

ctx.x: they couldn't drive the trucks but they were delivery men so they delivered the coca-colas all around and so forth and eventually he went from that to being a like he did that and he did stevedoring at night also with stevedo it was layer you know on the riverfront trucking stuff and just about at 1941 is when the war broke out he became a pullman porter on the train and that was

the troops and people all around up and down he led then left being from being a Pullman Porter he started working at the Corpus Christi Church and school down on St. Bernard Street just about that time I was getting in the high school in the flesh 48 of 46 something like that and 48 49 up to 50 I think it is that St. Augustine High School was built and opened by Father Oruk and my father they were the first two people there it was a summertime and him and Father Oruk arranged chairs and things in the school he…
